title: zkFold x zkPass: Bring zkPass to Cardano

ms.promise:
Context: zkPass on Cardano is a smart contract that enables developers to post, verify, and utilize zkPass oracle attestations on the Cardano blockchain. It is a tool that makes new types of DApps possible on Cardano.
Task: Create documentation for the smart contract, specifying what exactly it does. Additionally, we create the description of the API available to smart contract developers that want to use zkPass on Cardano.
Outputs:
・Smart contract specification (pdf)
・API documentation (pdf)
ms.criteria:
・Smart contract specification (pdf) can be found in the repo
・API documentation (pdf) can be found in the repo
ms.report:
We have created the documentation for the smart contract, specifying what exactly it does. Additionally, we have created the description of the API available to smart contract developers that want to use zkPass on Cardano.
Smart contract specification:
https://docs.zkfold.io/other-zkapps/zkpass/
API documentation:
https://docs.zkfold.io/other-zkapps/zkpass/#api

ms.report:
We have completed Milestone 4!

We have created a repository containing the frontend (client-side) code of the zkPass integration:
https://github.com/zkFold/zkpass-client
The core API functions of the integration are implemented here:
https://github.com/zkFold/zkpass-client/blob/main/src/components/ZkPassApp.tsx

Besides that, we have implemented the backend server to support the client-side part:
https://github.com/zkFold/zkpass-cardano
Specifically, we have completed the following update to the code:
https://github.com/zkFold/zkpass-cardano/pull/7/files

ms.promise:
